title: The Lazy Hardcoded Port/Bind Address
pattern: Statically hardcoding network bind addresses, interface names, or port numbers deep inside active functional methods.
why_bad: Prevents running multiple instances of the service on the same machine. It causes immediate startup crashes if port conflict occurs, and blocks deployments in standard container topologies.
detection: The presence of network binding actions referencing hardcoded host/port socket strings.
fix: Expose the bind address as a configuration parameter resolved at bootstrap; permit passing the parameter via environment variable or CLI argument.
source: [2nd] Andrew Hunt_ David Hurst Thomas - *The Pragmatic Programmer_ Your Journey to Mastery*, 20th Anniversary Edition (2019, Addison-Wesley Professional).pdf, Topic 32.
